name: atlan
description: Connect Atlan to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Atlan MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Atlan to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with data catalog and lineage using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Atlan workspace.
Find anything in Atlan that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review data catalog and lineage in Atlan.
